FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this activity helps.

This studio turns color choice into open-ended making. Children choose, tap and see the picture answer at once — and because nothing is graded, the choices are truly theirs. Naming colors out loud as they work doubles the learning, and the undo button means a brave choice is never a risk.

Finished pieces can be saved to the selected child’s My Classroom desk or downloaded as a picture to print. Save buttons appear under the board; everything stays on this device, private by design.
